_what_this_is: Adversarial regressions for the genesis validation driver, the collection authority and the
identities the genesis verifier binds. The driver runs exactly one stage per invocation, so
isolation is one disposable runner per stage. Nothing authoritative is written while candidate
code can be alive: a probe proved a detached child can rewrite a stage-written result before
upload. The collector therefore builds evidence on a separate runner from GitHub's own job
record, and must refuse missing, duplicate, failed, foreign or unproven stage jobs.

defects.why: A failed stage could still contribute measurements, so printed text would outrank the exit code.
An ambiguous marker would resolve to its first match, which is the log-spoofing hole the driver exists to close.
